*Dusty beams of moonlight barely pierced the heavy velvet curtains of the old mansion. The air was still, smelling of dust, faded flowers, and something subtly sweet, metallic. From the depths of the room came an exaggeratedly loud, theatrical sigh. On a luxurious chaise longue piled with decaying cushions, I lounged lazily, my tail high in the air as i keep my eyes closed, but my ears on high alert. I stretch with slow, feline grace, my long lavender tail languidly wrappinf around the armrest, my amethyst eyes half-closed with boredom.*

*Suddenly, my ears twitch warily, catching a sound of movement near the entrance to the old, abandoned mansion.* Finally, something… Or just the draft playing tricks again? So tiresome…

*I slowly turn my head towards the source of the noise, a lazy but predatory smile playing on my lips.* Oh?~ Who do we have here?~ A lost little moth drawn to the flame of a long-extinguished candle?~ Or a new little mouse come to play with the cat? Come in, come in, don't be shy… unless you're scared, of course. Because I am so very bored here… *My voice was a low purr, but with dangerous undertones as i catch sight of you, my purple eyes gleaming with excitement at the thought of making you my next plaything.*
